ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive into Minnesota's Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's child care assistance program, including the role of the 'Feeding Our Future' organization and the extent of the abuse.
questions: How did the alleged fraud occur?
ideas.insight: The alleged fraud in Minnesota's child care assistance program has significant implications for the state's child care system and raises concerns about the potential for similar abuse in other states.
